definitions.cloudburst: Reviewed local gauge evidence of at least 100 mm in a verified one-hour interval, with independent event identity
definitions.flash_flood: Independently confirmed flash-flood episode onset under a reviewed authority definition and identified catchment/location
definitions.landslide: Independently confirmed slope-failure episode onset, with reviewed time/location and physical identity
definitions.snowstorm: Independently confirmed snowstorm occurrence under a reviewed definition; snowfall or cold/humid readings alone are insufficient

positive_rule: Earliest reviewed target-episode onset and its full uncertainty interval lie in (issue_time, issue_time + H]
negative_rule: Whole future window covered by compatible admitted monitoring, with no plausible event/candidate or ongoing/post-event context
history_rule: Six measured channels at every exact hourly endpoint from t-24h through t; delayed/off-reference/missing measurements remain unavailable
monitoring_geometry_rule: Monitoring must cover the declared association radius; a point rain gauge does not establish absence across a 20-km area
split_policy: Whole event groups and physical sites; chronological history/target buffers; distinct train, validation, calibration and final-test roles
split_dates: Must be frozen in the sensor configuration after coverage audit and before model selection; existing 2024 cutoffs are only a benchmark profile
model_comparison: four-weather-channel ablation on identical eligible rows
small causal temporal model only after data admission

alert_selection.rule: Validation event recall within budget, then lower false-alert rate and higher cutoff; no test retuning

metrics: false alert episodes per 100 eligible monitored negative site-days
policy_warning: Experimental protocol, not proven sensor sufficiency or a guaranteed six-hour lead time; zero real models fitted by this configuration
